profile.title: Manage Sage Active subscription
profile.subtitle: Manage your Sage Active subscription and see what's included in each plan.

portal.name: Portal
portal.description: A lightweight business overview with file sharing capabilities to support communication between Client and Accountant.

starter.name: Starter
starter.description: Standard features for new businesses and also for those that outsource accounting management to an advisor.

essentials.name: Essentials
essentials.description: More advanced features for demanding businesses and companies with in-house accounting management.

control.name: Standard
control.description: Advanced inventory and stock management for businesses tracking stock across multiple locations, warehouses, and channels.

scale.name: Advanced
scale.description: Full manufacturing capabilities for businesses managing production, work orders, and materials from raw stock to finished goods.

fileUpload.title: File management
fileUpload.intro: Upload and manage files for your business. You can upload files up to 20 MB.
fileUpload.drop: or drag and drop your file

financialDocuments.title: Financial documents
financialDocuments.intro: Documents and videos uploaded by your accountant for you. New financial documents will appear when they are ready for you.
